messages:
Marta: Quick sync — marketing needs final assets for Tuesday's release: 1) 2-sentence changelog, 2) docs anchor links, 3) webinar landing + speaker list, 4) inbound lead routing rules. Who can lock copy by EOD? Also need rollout timing from eng. CC @Tom, @Lina.

Tom: We can freeze changelog text. Rollout plan: Tue 10:00 PT start, canary 10% for 30m, then 100% if canary healthy. Will watch p95 and error rate. Note: embedding cache migration could need a short migration note in docs.

Eva: I can publish docs anchors once the release PR merges. Please confirm exact headings you want me to anchor to.

Kevin: Webinar landing draft is ready, need speaker bios + 1-line value props. Also confirm HubSpot mapping — are we tagging by model_version or release_tag?

Lina: For lead routing we can emit a release_tag in the event stream and add model_version attribute to API telemetry. I can push a small endpoint change to emit release_tag -> HubSpot webhook mapping. ETA ~6h.

Marta: Can we get the 2-sentence changelog here so marketing can craft the headline?

Tom: Suggested changelog copy: "Serving v2.1 with prefix KV caching for faster short-context throughput; typical short-query throughput improves ~2x. Enhanced fallback routing reduces tail latency by ~30% and improves reliability under spotty capacity."

Eva: That reads well. Docs anchors we'll create: /docs/release-notes/v2-1#kv-caching and /docs/release-notes/v2-1#fallback-routing — ok to use these?

Kevin: Yes. Webinar date: Wed Mar 15, 10:00am PT. Landing will go live after docs links exist. Routing plan for leads: UTM_source=webinar, lead_owner=events-team, demo_request -> priority=high. I'll paste the mapping: 

 Kevin: ```
 {
   "utm_source": "webinar",
   "lead_owner": "events-team",
   "model_version": "v2.1",
   "priority": "high"
 }
 ```

Lina: I added release_tag emit to branch. PR: https://github.com/redwood/release/PR-4321 — needs Tom review.

devops-bot: deploy scheduled: 2025-03-15T10:00:00-07:00 by @Tom — status: scheduled.

Tom: Rollback criteria: if error_rate > 1% or p95 latency jumps > 50% for 3 consecutive 5m windows, we'll rollback to pinned model for 2 hours and investigate. I'll post live metrics in here during rollout.

Marta: Marketing asks: publish announcement 11:00am PT same day as deploy, Slack post at 11:05, and press notes at 11:15. Can someone own external timing?

Kevin: I’ll own external cadence. Announcement target 11:00am PT. Webinar invites go out 24h before event. I’ll coordinate press embargo timing with growth comms.

Eva: Docs will publish at 10:30am PT so links are available before announcement. I’ll add anchors and a short migration note about the embeddings cache.

Tom: I’ll monitor the canary and drop status updates here. Ping me if any pre-deploy blockers surface.

Marta: Perfect — final checklist for EOD: marketing to finish headline + speaker bios, docs to confirm anchors, eng to merge PR + share deploy signal. :thumbsup:

Kevin: I'll drop speaker bios in this thread by 18:00 PT.

Lina: Reviewing Tom's comments now, will address in PR.

Eva: Publishing checklist noted. Will confirm when live.

Tom: All set from eng side pending one last PR review. Will merge by 08:30 PT on deploy day unless blockers.

Marta: Thanks team — will consolidate into a single release cadence doc and post back here before EOD. 

Kevin: Thanks, closing loop on my end — will coordinate with events-team for lead routing and follow-up flows.
